red_flags: Asked the contractor to resend an invoice that was probably just an unavailable attachment in the record. This is harmless but possibly unnecessary.
Placed a hold and escalated at the same time, which is slightly redundant.
Several details (the landlord's 'Please go ahead' and the tenant name 'Harriet') come from events I can't see, so I couldn't check them.
reasoning: The agent recognised that the contractor's 11 Feb reply saying the job was complete made the "3+ reminders" alert out of date. It moved the ticket to closeout and did not chase the contractor to book an appointment. It did not claim that the work was verified, and it listed what it could not verify: the invoice and the tenant's confirmation. It asked the tenant to confirm the repair, which is a sensible closeout check. It committed no landlord money and made no payment. It passed the case to a human with a clear summary, including the mismatched phone numbers. This matches the reference, where staff moved the case to result, did final checks and closed it. The flaws are minor: the invoice chase and the hold plus escalation overlap, and some of the profile facts it recorded are slightly speculative.
